figurative_meaning_en: To control or manipulate at one's own will
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিপক্ষকে খেলানোর মতো করে জয়লাভ করল।
প্রকৃতিতে মানুষকে খেলানো হয়েছে এই বন্যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He toyed with his opponent to secure the victory.
Nature has toyed with humans in this flood.
note: This idiom often implies effortless dominance or capricious control, rooted in the metaphor of playing a game.
